note: Site BV019 (Broad Mountain Landing 2) on Broad Mountain Road, 0.1 mile north of Lookout Trail: an old log landing, a bare clearing about 40 m by 15 m at the end of a 325-ft track off the road, that DCNR says holds one camper trailer or two vehicles with tents. Easy access and somewhat secluded; no fire ring or picnic table is listed. About 3 miles of Broad Mountain Road along the ridge from Shearer Road above Upper Strasburg. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: open year round, bookable (nights offered Nov 2026, May and Jul 2027), $10/$15 + $6.50, 40 ft, back-in gravel, slight, 325-ft driveway, 20-ft clearance. Imagery rendered (leaf-on): a bare pale landing ~40 x 15 m at the pin with a track running about 100 m SE to Broad Mountain Road. 3DEP: level with the track (678 m). No NHD flowline within 200 m. Pin matches ReserveAmerica and DCNR GIS (TrailerAccess 'Yes').
flags: What it is: a log landing used as a campsite ('Grass parking lot that can hold 1 camper trailer or 2 vehicles with tents. Easy access that is somewhat secluded'); imagery shows bare shale or gravel rather than grass. No amenities listed on the booking page.
Equipment categories on the site page: 'RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site'.

Bear Valley brochure (July 2026): the one site marked 'CLOSED for Evaluation and Maintenance' is BV008 Clarks Knob (Broad Mountain Road at Clarks Knob Road), not this site. BV008 is on the same road; Broad Mountain Road itself is not reported closed.

Access: OSRM routes Fort McCord Road, Gilbert Road 2.6 miles, Shearer Road, then Broad Mountain Road 2.97 miles on the ridge (about 2,200 ft). Surface, gates and weight limits unread (Overpass did not answer).
Winter: the Buchanan camping page states no closure period.
